promotionRule: No Batch 081 route is eligible for generation or promotion until its documented identity, scope, representation, evidence, analytical, and clinical-translation conflicts are corrected and independently re-audited.

routeDecisions.reason: Oxidation state, chemical species, fractionation, and bioavailability are conflated, with categorical biological claims that omit matrix, pH, ligands, kinetics, preservation, and analytical method.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Define one element, matrix, physical-chemical conditions, time scale, preservation, separation/detection method, and operationally identified species.

routeDecisions.reason: Diverse direct-transfer, scaffold, carrier, accessory, and energy-dependent systems are presented as one universal escort and kinetic-control mechanism.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Rebuild by organism, protein identifier/structure, metal species, client, compartment, stoichiometry, nucleotide dependence, demonstrated interaction, and assay.

routeDecisions.reason: The singular and plural routes cover the same concept while receptor, concentration, epidemiological, and disease-causality claims exceed the cited evidence.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Reconcile the duplicate canonical identity and separate chemical species, receptor, assay, concentration, model, tissue, and human outcome.

routeDecisions.reason: Heterogeneous ions, species, assays, receptors, doses, and disease observations are combined into one causal class despite conflicting human evidence.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Merge or distinguish the duplicate route; grade evidence per chemical species and endpoint and separate hypotheses from established human effects.

routeDecisions.reason: Exploratory multi-element studies are presented as disease-specific diagnostic tiers despite heterogeneous matrices and methods, small cohorts, and absent prospective validation.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Rebuild around specimen, analyte, preanalytics, platform, calibration/QC, interference control, batch correction, multiplicity, external validation, and intended use.

routeDecisions.reason: Organism- and family-specific sensors are generalized into universal ligand, network-collapse, virulence, co-selection, and drug-target rules.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Rebuild by organism/strain, regulator identifier/structure, family, metal species, sites/stoichiometry, operator/regulon, assay, mutant phenotype, and in-vivo evidence.
